verified_facts.text: Alila Solo rises above a main avenue in Solo known for dining and retail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Alila Solo rising above a main avenue known for vibrant dining and retail

verified_facts.text: Solo, also known as Surakarta, is the older of the two royal capitals of Central Java and preserves walled royal palaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: The older of the two royal capitals of Central Java, Surakarta—or Solo, as it is better known— preserves its rich history in elegant walled royal palaces.

verified_facts.text: The 9th-century Borobudur temple is about two hours from Solo.
verified_facts.excerpt: About two hours from Solo, the 9th-century Borobudur temple

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites are spread across eight towers of staggered heights.
verified_facts.excerpt: spread across eight towers of staggered heights

verified_facts.text: The high-ceilinged lobby features batik-inspired art.
verified_facts.excerpt: The monumental, high-ceilinged lobby features batik-inspired art that sets the tone for a distinctive stay

verified_facts.text: The Alila Suite has a private plunge pool, a private terrace and a luxury bathroom with a rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside this 90 square meter suite, discover one king bed, a private plunge pool, private terrace, and a luxury bathroom with a rain shower.

verified_facts.text: Guests in Deluxe rooms and suites get access to the Sky Lounge on Level 30.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevate your stay with exclusive access to the Sky Lounge on Level 30, available exclusively to guests staying in our Deluxe Rooms and Suites.

verified_facts.text: Some rooms have a mountain view and a bathroom with a rainfall shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Modern 40-square-meter room with a breathtaking mountain view, outfitted with one king bed and a bathroom with rainfall shower.

verified_facts.text: AGRA is a rooftop lounge with an indoor area and an outdoor terrace, offering cocktails, live music and DJ sets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind indoors or out on the terrace at Agra, the highest rooftop lounge in Central Java. Take in the glimmering lights of the city while savoring eclectic comfort food and creative cocktails alongside live music and DJ sets.

verified_facts.text: The main restaurant, Epice, serves farm-to-table dining with Javanese and Western accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor farm-to-table dining with Javanese and Western accents at our main restaurant Épice

verified_facts.text: Spa Alila has therapeutic pools and herbal-infused steam rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: then indulge in our therapeutic pools and herbal-infused steam rooms

verified_facts.text: Spa Alila's therapists are local and trained in anatomical physiology, massage and meditation.
verified_facts.excerpt: our local therapists—trained in anatomical physiology, massage, meditation and service

verified_facts.text: The Largo pool area is an open, tree-dotted space with loungers and sofa pods.
verified_facts.excerpt: An open, breezy space dotted with trees invites poolside relaxation on sleek loungers and plush sofa pods.

verified_facts.text: The Harvest Bliss experience takes guests to the rice paddies of Klaten to plant, harvest and catch fish by hand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into the rhythms of rural Java in the rice paddies and waters of Klaten. Plant, harvest and even catch fish with your hands

verified_facts.text: The Studio Sessions experience lets guests record a song at the Lokananta recording studio and take the recording home.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore the archives, step into the legendary studio and mix your own recording to take home.

verified_facts.text: The Threads and Blades experience explores batik and keris, visiting the house of Go Tik Swan and a master keris smith.
verified_facts.excerpt: Trace the legacy of Java through two of its most powerful art forms—batik and keris. From the noble house of Go Tik Swan to a master keris smith

verified_facts.text: A morning experience visits the Pasar Gede market in Solo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Depart Alila Solo for an early morning visit to Pasar Gede
